slot.brief: Soap bubble of given radius and surface tension; find the excess pressure inside, or the work done to blow it up from zero radius to the stated radius.

stem: A soap bubble of radius $5.0$ mm is formed in air. If the surface tension of the soap solution is $0.025$ N m$^{-1}$, what is the excess pressure inside the bubble?

verdicts.working: For a soap bubble, excess pressure is \(\Delta P=4T/r=4(0.025)/(0.005)=20\,\text{Pa}\).

working:
$$\Delta P=\dfrac{4T}{R}=\dfrac{4(0.025)}{5.0\times10^{-3}}=20\ \text{Pa}$$
